article.headline: Belmont takes down Furman 72-62
article.description: — Vincent Neugebauer’s 17 points helped Belmont defeat Furman 72-62 on Saturday.
article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Vincent Neugebauer’s 17 points helped Belmont defeat Furman 72-62 on Saturday. Neugebauer added six rebounds for the Bruins (3-1). Jack Smiley added 15 points, six assists and three steals. Jabez Jenkins finished with 10 points. Cameron Elwer led the way for the Paladins (4-1) with 13 points. Tom House added 11 points for Furman. Charles Johnston had 10 points. Neugebauer scored eight points in the first half and Belmont went into halftime trailing 33-30. Belmont pulled off the victory after a 21-2 second-half run erased a five-point deficit and gave the Bruins the lead at 60-46 with 5:08 remaining in the half. Up next Both teams play again on Wednesday. Belmont hosts Union (KY) and Furman travels to play Radford. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
